summary: Emergent Google Auth integration end-to-end verified. 18/18 backend pytest cases pass (10 new auth tests + 8 regression). Frontend flows all green: /login shows testids, google-signin-btn redirects to https://auth.emergentagent.com/, unauth /admin/enquiries redirects to /login, session_token cookie unlocks /admin/enquiries showing admin-enquiries + admin-user-card + logout-btn with correct user, contact form submission appears in admin table, logout invalidates session (subsequent /admin/enquiries -> /login).
critical_code_review_comments: test_credentials.md at /app/memory/test_credentials.md is empty. Since this app uses Emergent Google OAuth (no static test users), it is acceptable — but E1 could add a note documenting the mongo-seed approach used in /app/auth_testing.md so future testing agents know where to look.
Backend still uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown'); consider migrating to FastAPI lifespan handler.

backend/server.py: created_at is stored as ISO string in Mongo but Pydantic model declares datetime. Both list_enquiries and get_current_user manually parse ISO strings — a minor inconsistency; either always store native datetime or always store string with a codec.

Frontend AuthProvider does not currently expose a way to short-circuit /auth/me when there is no session_token cookie — every anonymous page load makes a 401 request. Cosmetic (works fine), but easy to gate on document.cookie.
test_credentials: No static credentials. Auth tested by seeding a users + user_sessions doc directly in MongoDB (test_database.users / test_database.user_sessions) per /app/auth_testing.md. Session token used as Authorization: Bearer <token> for API and as session_token cookie (secure, sameSite=None, httpOnly, path=/) for browser tests against the preview domain.
seed_data_creation: Seeded a fresh user + session directly in Mongo for both backend fixture and Playwright frontend tests. Also created a handful of TEST_-prefixed enquiries via the public POST endpoint and via the UI Contact form. All seeded users, sessions and TEST_ enquiries were cleaned up at end of run (verified via mongosh: 1 user, 15 enquiries removed; sessions were already teared down by module fixtures).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth uses Emergent-managed Google OAuth. Do NOT attempt real Google login in tests. Use the exact seed pattern in /app/auth_testing.md: insert into users + user_sessions with a custom user_id (never touch _id) and pass the session_token as (a) Authorization: Bearer for API and (b) an httpOnly, secure, sameSite=None cookie named session_token for browser tests. Backend cookie flags in server.py match what Playwright injects (secure=True, samesite='none'), so cross-origin is fine. Tests: `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v` (requires REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL + MONGO_URL + DB_NAME env vars). All 18 tests should pass green in ~3s.
rca of the issue: No open issues. Integration verified end-to-end (mongo seed -> backend bearer -> frontend cookie -> protected route -> logout -> re-gated route).
